title: Certified Optimal Assignment Designs with Prescribed Unequal Treatment Probabilities
banked_reason: D-0.5 angle 0 v6 exhausted its revision cap after reviewer REVISE: ass:weighted-outcome-span and ass:coefficient-ball remained mis-tagged as standard consumer conditions.
gap_reasons: The exact zero-residual restriction mu=B^T theta is a restrictive consumer model, not the standard Harshaw et al. condition cited under that name; retag it novel and justify its scientific setting, or cite a source imposing this exact span.

The unit Euclidean coefficient ball is an additional normalization for the proposal's consumer risk, not a standard condition established by the cited Gram--Schmidt-walk result; retag it novel with an application-scale justification.
proof_attempt_summary: Six D-0.5 proposal revisions refined a field-rated PrefixCert kernel for rational finite-support recovery and locally checkable two-sided additive certificates. The run exhausted its angle cap before derivation because the exact outcome-span and coefficient-ball restrictions were still structurally tagged as standard consumer assumptions after an explicit repair directive and one consult-approved extra revision. No D0 derivation or Lean formalization was started; a future retry should remove the orphan Horvitz--Thompson consumer bridge and preserve the standalone PrefixCert kernel.
tldr: For prescribed unequal treatment probabilities, the headline result is a fixed-row prefix-lattice algorithm that emits an explicit rational finite-support design together with a positive-semidefinite, Bellman-verifiable additive instance-optimal interval of width \(2^{-b}\). Separate real and rational flow representations support exact minimax and finite rational output without conflating the two. The algorithm separates in \((H,\alpha,\beta)\)-space by an \(O(E_{\mathrm{lat}})\) backward lattice recurrence, recovers an exact rational flow from the oracle transcript, and repairs feasibility in exact arithmetic; a distinct joint algebraic certificate covers exact irrational optima. Rao--Zhang's feasible laws already impose prescribed population marginals and their Eq. (3) already supplies the Horvitz--Thompson covariance/MSE bridge. The strict delta is the rational finite-support representation paired with a locally checkable lower certificate and a two-sided additive instance-optimal interval. Zero-row padding is only a definitional implementation observation for an auditable benchmark.
gap: Unequal-margin DDM already optimizes over laws with the prescribed probabilities and supplies an accuracy-dependent upper-only benchmark guarantee, but it supplies neither an additive instance-optimal lower interval nor an explicit rational finite-support representation paired with a locally checkable certificate; generic exact SDP results do not supply the pathwise certificate.
fill: The field-level contribution is PrefixCert: a real minimax representation coupled to rational Bellman separation, transcript-based primal recovery, exact residual repair, and finite path decomposition that emits the law and its two-sided additive certificate. Sparse compression, the known Horvitz--Thompson bridge, and zero-row padding are supporting components rather than novelty claims.
